title: Kissinger directs the CFR study group on nuclear weapons

tellings.quote: In 1955, Kissinger was invited to direct a Council on Foreign Relations study group on nuclear war and foreign policy.

plain: In 1955, Michels says, Henry Kissinger was invited to direct a Council on Foreign Relations study group on nuclear war and foreign policy, and this led to his book Nuclear Weapons and Foreign Policy. Michels links the group to J. Robert Oppenheimer and to the atomic energy official Gordon Dean. He tells it himself, on an episode asking whether Kissinger oversaw a programme to recover crashed UFOs, because the job would have put Kissinger right among the people who kept the country's deepest secrets.
